hotspots.title: AfD surges in Saxony-Anhalt election with far-right extremism fears
hotspots.blurb: Polls placing the AfD at over 40% ahead of the Saxony-Anhalt state election have ignited a national panic over the prospect of Germany's first far-right state government. Opponents warn of existential threats to public broadcasting, economic decline, and systemic attacks on democratic institutions, while political rivals struggle with the collapse of the political 'firewall'.
hotspots.affect: The real threat of an unrestrained far-right victory generates intense democratic alarm, economic panic, and existential urgency across the political spectrum.

hotspots.title: Vox escalates Ceuta sovereignty crisis against Sánchez
hotspots.blurb: Vox and right-wing coalition partners are spearheading high-intensity street demonstrations and European Parliament protests regarding the ongoing migrant crisis in Ceuta. Santiago Abascal and party leaders have repeatedly accused Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez of 'treason' and failing to protect national borders against Moroccan 'hybrid warfare'.
hotspots.affect: Incendiary claims of government betrayal and invasion rhetoric create a volatile emotional climate around national sovereignty and border defense.

hotspots.title: Javier Milei’s Malvinas national address after Trump’s remarks
hotspots.blurb: Argentine President Javier Milei delivered a primetime national address asserting 'sacred' sovereignty claims over the Falkland Islands (Malvinas) and announcing new sanctions and a naval base project. The dramatic policy shift follows comments from Donald Trump questioning US support for British control, provoking strong rhetoric from Buenos Aires and quick dismissal from London.
hotspots.affect: Patriotic grievance framing and high-stakes territorial posture generate widespread fervor and international diplomatic tension.

hotspots.title: Lega Nord rebellion challenges Salvini’s leadership
hotspots.blurb: An internal revolt has erupted within Italy's Lega party as old-guard northern autonomists established a 'Federal Congress Committee' demanding a return to the party's regionalist roots. As Matteo Salvini attempts to project unity and hold off rising far-right rival Roberto Vannacci, northern dissidents threaten legal and political action to reclaim the original Lega Nord symbol.
hotspots.affect: Accusations of ideological betrayal and power struggles produce a sharp leadership crisis atmosphere and existential intra-party fighting.

hotspots.title: Trump administration’s AI copyright stance sparks controversy
hotspots.blurb: The Justice Department has formally backed OpenAI in its legal battle against news publishers, arguing that training AI models on copyrighted material constitutes 'fair use' and is essential for American national security. The administration's sudden pivot away from intellectual property protections has outraged media organizations and sparked sharp legal debate over government overreach.
hotspots.affect: Framing artificial intelligence training as a national security imperative sets up a high-stakes conflict with traditional media and copyright defenders.
